UPDATE repo_mappings
            SET harbor_cred_id = ?, github_cred_id = ?, harbor_base_url = ?,
                harbor_project = ?, harbor_repository = ?, github_owner = ?, github_repo = ?,
                auto_create_issues = ?, min_issue_severity = ?, default_branch = ?
          WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?
